entries.title: Canvas adapter peer conflict
entries.root_cause: The root project pins @gloamforge/canvas-core 4.2.0 while @gloamforge/canvas-inspector 3.1.0 requires canvas-core ^3.0.0. Align the inspector and core versions.

entries.title: Timeline adapter peer conflict
entries.root_cause: The root project pins @gloamforge/timeline-core 5.0.0 while @gloamforge/timeline-ruler 2.4.0 requires timeline-core ^4.0.0. Align the ruler and timeline core versions.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same npm peer resolution error involves the timeline packages, which require a separate dependency alignment.

entries.title: Missing build configuration
entries.root_cause: The build command points to config/harbor.build.mjs, but the checked-out repository contains config/harbor.bundle.mjs instead. Correct the configuration path in the build script.

entries.title: Canvas adapter peer conflict returns
entries.root_cause: The root project pins @gloamforge/canvas-core 4.2.0 while @gloamforge/canvas-inspector 3.1.0 requires canvas-core ^3.0.0. Align the inspector and core versions.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later pull request on a different runner fails during npm install instead of npm ci; the same incompatible canvas package versions are reported.
